mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the risk-free rate, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime constraints.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings potential and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payroll employment (PAYEMS rise > 0.5%) and unemployment rate (UNRATE rise > 0.1pp) indicate shrinking labor force participation, signaling economic stress and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rise > 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a monthly CPI increase (MoM > 0.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL MoM rise > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and MoM rise > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST > 1600) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold constraints.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) signals manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An ultra-low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) directly lowers equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in the current rate environment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ > 1.0%) signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days in growth regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ growth > 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
